 KHON Honolulu Follow Richard Bissen leads race for Maui mayor
 Carley Matsumura Wed, November 4, 2026 at 1:19 AM UTC 1 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. All Results | Governor | Maui Mayor | Kauai Mayor | US House District 2 | Honolulu City Council District 4 | State House District 43 | State Senate District 20 | All Island Charter Questions 
 WAIKLUKU, Hawaii (KHON2) -- Richard Bissen currently leads the race for Maui's mayor seat.
 In the second printout, Bissen leads the race with 23,109 votes, over Yuki Lei Sugimura, who has 18,779 votes.
 Incumbent Bissen, a former judge, is running for another four years in office to complete the progress he began. Maui County Councilmember Sugimura wants a chance to bring her vision and commitment to the mayor's seat.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement  PREVIOUSLY: Maui County mayoral candidates make final push as Election Day approaches  
 Before being elected as Maui's mayor in 2022, Bissen served as Maui County Prosecuting Attorney and First Deputy Attorney General.
 If re-elected, his priorities will include emergency preparedness and water infrastructure.
 To learn more about Bissen and his campaign, click HERE .
 Sugimura, a Maui County Councilmember who served for 10 years, said she wants to deliver "real results."
 Her campaign focused on three main principles: rebuilding trust in county government, housing and supporting the local economy.
 For more information on Sugimura and her campaign, click HERE .

 Both candidates identify affordability and housing as the major concerns for constituents.
